rows.citation_human: Jaimini Sutram 1.2 (karakāṃśa-phala) / BPHS Ch.34: Moon casting Jaimini chara-rāśi-dṛṣṭi on the karakāṃśa (Aries) from Aquarius gives trade in liquids, agriculture, employment under authority. Ātmakāraka=Moon; karakāṃśa reckoned as the D9 sign of the Ātmakāraka (ga_sensitive karakamsa_position, §N.5). Aspect model: Jaimini chara-rāśi-dṛṣṭi (sign aspects), not Parāśari graha aspects.

BPHS Ch.39 (Raja Yoga adhyaya), neecha-bhanga verses; also Phaladeepika Ch.7 (Raja Yoga): the lord of the sign of debilitation placed in a kendra from the Lagna or from the Moon cancels the debility. | BPHS Ch.39 (Raja Yoga adhyaya), neecha-bhanga verses; also Phaladeepika Ch.7 (Raja Yoga): the graha that is exalted in the debilitated planet's sign of debilitation, placed in a kendra from the Lagna or from the Moon, cancels the debility.
